organization_logic.macro_structure: 17 prose pages + 11-page appendix (Python code). Three-model pipeline: CoopStructure (7 pages) -> SlidingWindow (4 pages) -> Strategy (3 pages) -> Generalization (1 page) -> Strengths/Weaknesses (2 pages).
organization_logic.dominant_pattern: Linear pipeline: network construction -> structure identification -> temporal analysis -> strategic recommendation -> domain extension
organization_logic.section_coupling: Strong sequential coupling: Model 1 provides structure types to Model 3; Model 2 provides highlight periods to Model 3. Generalization section weakly coupled (analogical, no data).
organization_logic.argument_quality: Solid data-driven pipeline through case studies. Weakened by lack of statistical tests for frequency differences and unsupported generalization.
human_organization_signals: In-this-way repeated as paragraph closure (zheyang calque)
Creative naming of six cooperation structures
Photograph metaphor for sliding window concept
global_organization_chain: Context (soccer + complex system) -> Problem (quantify cooperation via network)
Foundation (directed network + 6D features) -> Clustering (hierarchical + PCA -> 6 types)
Evaluation (sliding window: ANC + transitivity) -> Case studies (Match 15, Match 23)
Application (frequency comparison + formation recommendation) -> Warning (Absolute Suppress)

main_argument_chains.claim: Team cooperation can be decomposed into six distinct structural patterns via network clustering.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without structure taxonomy, the paper would only capture aggregate network statistics and miss the tactical patterns that distinguish cooperation modes.

main_argument_chains.claim: Sliding window analysis captures temporal performance dynamics invisible to whole-match aggregates.
support_steps: define 900-second window justified by warm-up time
compute ANC and transitivity at each position
identify highlight periods above season average
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without temporal decomposition, performance analysis would average out critical moment-by-moment variations that determine match outcomes.

main_argument_chains.claim: Coaching strategy should emphasize counter-attack and 4-4-2 based on cooperation structure strengths.
support_steps: compare structure frequency Huskies vs opponents
identify highlight-period strength in Defensive Shield and Midfield Overall Planning
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without data-driven tactical analysis, the coach would rely on intuition rather than systematic evidence of which cooperation patterns succeed.
